game_concept: A speed quiz set in The Kingdom – Chapel Gardens, the chapel gardens: the herald must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Score Keeper: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while rogue crows close in.
theme: The Kingdom – Chapel Gardens: the chapel gardens
core_gameplay_loop: In Chapel Gardens, repeat each round: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while rogue crows close in. Each round, a new arrows challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the score value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 290 points of arrows by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 290, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 9 (extended tier): Score Keeper
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Score Keeper' (Week 1 slot 6), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Chapel Gardens'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Chapel Gardens.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 290 within 76 seconds.
